_doc: A 40 x 40 mm slotted aluminium profile as sold unbranded ("4040, 40x40 slot 8, I-type light"): a stand-in until the bar in hand is measured (cad measure, or a caliper and cad rules draft profile). Its outline is one named seller's CAD outline (KJN), its section figures and alloy another's catalogue (Dold Mechatronik), and every figure is community. This is the light section; a heavy one with no corner hollows is sold under the same name (KJN IR02603: 916 mm², 2.47 kg/m), and Far-East "4040" stock has lips about 2 mm thick, not 4.5. The drawn outline leaves out the rounded mouths, the pocket cut behind each lip (which makes the lips hooks) and the curve of the flanks, so it comes out about a fifth heavier and stiffer than the sellers' figures: a beam should use those, not the drawn ones.
